title: File:Crites Bldg, Bakersfield, CA.jpg
author: Publichall
description: The Arthur S. Crites Building at the SW corner of 19th and Eye Streets. Originally built in 1901 by J.B. Berges for the Redlick Brothers department store who occupied the entire building until 1911.
